capabilities: Automatically create virtual links for text matching note titles, aliases, and headers
Convert virtual links to real links via right-click
Scope matching to specific folders, tags, or excluded keywords and file extensions
Jump to a specific line via obsidian://adv-uri links
Toggle virtual link rendering by mode or command
disambiguation: The virtual links are rendered only in the editor and never written to files, so they do not appear in Graph View or affect backlink counts.
extras: The README notes a limitation: the toggle command cannot fully disable rendering in Canvas and Tables, and users are pointed to other plugins or QuickAdd scripts for a full on/off switch. Enabling the line-jumping feature requires disabling the Advanced URI plugin because Obsidian allows only one plugin per protocol.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a fork of Virtual Linker / Glossary.
motivation: The original Virtual Linker / Glossary plugin broke after Obsidian API updates in 2025, so the author forked it to fix compatibility, improve IME support and stability, and add header-targeting links.
problem: Manually creating [[wiki links]] for every mention of a note title is tedious and clutters Markdown files with duplicated link syntax.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a fork of Virtual Linker / Glossary.
the recommended way is to install the Advanced URI plugin and use its "Copy URI" command

summary: Fork of Virtual Linker that renders virtual links for text matching note titles, aliases, or headers, without writing them into the Markdown source.
